_schema_note: Append-only. A decision's identity is the (category, subject) pair.

decisions.subject: Production pipeline
decisions.selected: promo-video governance with explainer-video subject grammar
options_considered: promo-video governance with explainer-video subject grammar
decisions.rejected_because: The user required the promo-video method and a complete local, auditable production.

decisions.subject: Render runtime
decisions.rejected_because: The required local toolchain is installed and the promo-video contract fixes HyperFrames; Remotion was considered as the required alternative.

decisions.subject: Hero composition approach
decisions.rejected_because: A custom monolithic composition best supports a distinct, tightly synchronized promotional arc without inheriting the companion template look.

decisions.subject: Narration voice
decisions.rejected_because: The production contract specifies measured local Kokoro narration and the existing environment imports successfully.

decisions.subject: Music bed
decisions.rejected_because: A subtle pulse supports the sharper promo arc without licensing ambiguity or network dependency.

decisions.subject: Master delivery
decisions.rejected_because: The brief asks for one approximately 60-second promo; 1080p is the proven HyperFrames master profile.

decisions.subject: Production validation
decisions.selected: locked script, measured audio, lint, check, all scene midpoints, render, ffprobe, loudness and final-frame review
decisions.rejected_because: The user explicitly requires every gate and re-rendering until passing.

decisions.subject: Production record and credit
decisions.selected: self-contained source production with Idan Shimon method credit
options_considered: self-contained source production with Idan Shimon method credit
decisions.rejected_because: The brief requires all sources and explicit originator credit in the close or production record.

decisions.subject: Narration voice
decisions.rejected_because: The measured speed-1.1 narration totaled 68.975 seconds before scene gaps. Speed 1.33 preserves the locked words while targeting an approximately 60-second composition.

decisions.subject: Narration mix gain
decisions.selected: deterministic 1.4x gain in TTS source generation
options_considered: deterministic 1.4x gain in TTS source generation
leave the first master at -29.4 dB mean
decisions.rejected_because: The first rendered master measured -29.4 dB mean and -9.3 dB max. Source-level gain keeps reproduction truthful and targets the promo-video method's normal -25 to -28 dB master range without clipping.
